summary: Publish stalled launchd health before child cleanup and recover probe admission after an unwind.

replay.detail: No claim format or replay change.

compatibility.detail: launchctl has a three-second RPC deadline, then kill and reap on timeout; kernel reap latency is not bounded by that deadline. The daemon publishes launchd-unresponsive health at the deadline, before cleanup can block. Single-flight admission remains held through cleanup. Backoff is measured from the deadline. Poisoned admission and health locks are recovered rather than wedging future observations until restart.

downtime.detail: Restart the daemon to activate early health publication and poison recovery; no state migration is required.

manual.detail: No new configuration. Linux tests cover publication before cleanup, single-flight retention, kill and reap, and unwind recovery. Real macOS launchd stalls and stuck kernel reaping are not exercised.

recovery.detail: Responsive launchd clears the failure on the next admitted completed RPC. A stuck reap retains the one owned child and admission while health remains readable.
